# Tools reference

The Collie MCP server (`collie` 0.4.0) exposes **55 tools**. This page is generated from the server's own `tools/list` answer, so it matches the bundle in this repository. Regenerate it with `node scripts/gen-tools-reference.mjs`.

**Access** comes from each tool's MCP annotations:

- **read**: changes nothing in Collie (`readOnlyHint`).
- **write**: saves something in Collie. **may replace**: calling it again replaces what it saved before (`destructiveHint`). No tool deletes anything in Collie.
- **external**: reaches sources outside Collie, such as PubMed or OpenAlex (`openWorldHint`).

A read token can only call tools that do not send data to Collie. Some read tools send a query (for example `search_count`, `explore_search`, `ask_data`) and answer `token_read_only` to a read token. See [authentication](authentication.md#token-scopes).

Tool names here are the server's names. Clients add a prefix: in the Claude Code plugin, `review_get` is `mcp__plugin_collie_collie__review_get`.

## Connection and setup

### `collie_connection_status`

**Collie connection status** · Access: read

Is this agent connected to the user's Collie account? Returns connected + user name, or pending/expired/denied/not_connected. wait_seconds (max 120) waits for a pending approval to finish before answering.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wait_seconds` | integer | no | Value min 0, max 120. Default `0`. |

### `collie_connect`

**Connect to Collie** · Access: write

Connect this agent to the user's Collie account without copying tokens: opens Collie in the browser, where the user signs in and TYPES the code shown here to approve (a link alone never approves); the token is saved locally and every Collie tool works afterwards. Call only when collie_connection_status says not connected and the user wants to use Collie. Show the returned link + code in one line and ask the user to type the code on that page, then wait (collie_connection_status wait_seconds).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client` | string | no | Name shown on the approval page, e.g. "Claude Code", "Codex", "Gemini CLI", "Cursor", "Perplexity" Length max 60. |

### `collie_disconnect`

**Disconnect from Collie** · Access: write, may replace

Forget the saved connection on this computer. Revoke the token itself in Collie › Settings › AI agents.

No parameters.

### `collie_setup`

**Set up Collie in an AI client** · Access: read

Install commands for the Collie plugin/skills and the MCP config snippet for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and Perplexity (Mac app), plus token scopes: read tokens only read (writes get token_read_only), write tokens read and write, no token can ever delete (token_cannot_delete).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `client` | `all` \| `claude-code` \| `codex` \| `gemini` \| `cursor` \| `perplexity` | no | Default `"all"`. |

## Reviews, protocol and criteria

### `review_list`

**List reviews** · Access: read

List the reviews the token's user is a member of (id, title, role, number of articles).

No parameters.

### `review_get`

**Review overview** · Access: read

Review settings, data summary (imports, duplicates), members and screening progress.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |

### `viability_check`

**Viability check (existing SRs)** · Access: read, external

Searches PubMed with the systematic-review filter for reviews that already answer this question. Default query: the review's latest PubMed search, else its title. verdict: existing_reviews | room_for_review - a hint for the human, not a decision.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `query` | string | no | Length max 4000. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Value min 1, max 50. Default `10`. |

### `protocol_get`

**Review protocol (PROSPERO fields)** · Access: read

The review's protocol in PROSPERO field order: saved fields, status (not_started|draft|submitted|registered), PROSPERO number (CRD…), completeness %, and `suggestions` — drafts built from what the review already holds (title, question, criteria, searches with dates, outcomes, RoB tools in use, analysis settings). Set format to md|txt to get the copy-paste export instead.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `format` | `md` \| `txt` | no |  |

### `protocol_set`

**Save protocol fields / registration status** · Access: write, may replace

Merges protocol fields (empty string clears one) and/or sets status and the PROSPERO number (CRD + digits) with its date (YYYY-MM-DD). Agents draft; save only text the user approved. Collie never submits to PROSPERO — the review team registers at https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/prospero/ (before data extraction starts) and then records the CRD number here.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `fields` | object of string | no |  |
| `status` | `not_started` \| `draft` \| `submitted` \| `registered` | no |  |
| `registration_id` | string | no | Length max 20. |
| `registered_at` | string | no | Length max 10. |

### `criteria_get`

**Eligibility criteria** · Access: read

Inclusion and exclusion criteria of a review.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |

### `criteria_set`

**Set eligibility criteria** · Access: write, may replace

Replace the inclusion/exclusion criteria lists (owner only). Confirm with the user before calling.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `inclusion` | array of string | yes | Items max 100. |
| `exclusion` | array of string | yes | Items max 100. |

### `audit_log`

**Audit log** · Access: read

Who changed what in the review, newest first: actor human (web app) or ai (MCP token), action, time. Page with before = nextBefore.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `actor` | `human` \| `ai` | no |  |
| `limit` | integer | no | Value min 1, max 200. Default `50`. |
| `before` | integer | no | Value above 0. |

**Validate search against known studies** · Access: read, external

Checks that the search retrieves studies you already know belong in the review. studies: first-author surnames or PMIDs. A missed known study means the strategy needs more synonyms/MeSH - fix the query, then re-validate.

## Explore and citations

### `explore_search`

**Literature explorer search** · Access: read, external

Relevance-ranked PubMed (with OpenAlex citation counts) or OpenAlex search. Returns works with ids usable in citation_graph / citation_import.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `query` | string | yes | Length min 2, max 4000. |
| `source` | `pubmed` \| `openalex` | no | Default `"pubmed"`. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Value min 1, max 100. Default `25`. |

### `citation_graph`

**Citation graph** · Access: read, external

From seed works (PMIDs or OpenAlex W-ids): mode similar (PubMed neighbours), references (backward citation searching) or citations (forward). Returns nodes + edges (from cites to).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `ids` | array of string | yes | Items min 1, max 50. |
| `mode` | `similar` \| `references` \| `citations` | no | Default `"similar"`. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Value min 5, max 150. Default `40`. |

### `citation_import`

**Import works as citation searching** · Access: write, external

Adds works (PMIDs / OpenAlex W-ids) to the review as one 'Citation searching' search - PRISMA counts them under other methods; they go through normal deduplication. Only import what the user asked for.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `ids` | array of string | yes | Items min 1, max 500. |

### `explore_ideas_get`

**Saved Explore ideas** · Access: read

Works the team saved for later in the Explore citation graph (one per work: workId = PMID or OpenAlex W-id, title, meta, note, tags, status idea | to_read | imported | dismissed). Use them as candidate seeds for citation_graph or, when the user asks, citation_import.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |

### `explore_idea_save`

**Save an Explore idea** · Access: write, may replace

Saves (upserts by work) a work as an idea for later with a note and tags - it shows up in the Explore Ideas panel and on the canvas. It does not add a record to the review; citation_import does that (and marks the idea imported). Save only what the user asked for.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `work_id` | string | yes | Pattern `^(\d{1,9}\|W\d{1,12})$`. |
| `title` | string | no | Length max 1000. Default `""`. |
| `note` | string | no | Length max 5000. Default `""`. |
| `tags` | array of string | no | Items max 20. Default `[]`. |
| `status` | `idea` \| `to_read` \| `imported` \| `dismissed` | no | Default `"idea"`. |
| `meta` | object | no |  |
| `meta.authors` | array of string | no | Items max 20. |
| `meta.year` | integer | no |  |
| `meta.journal` | string | no | Length max 500. |
| `meta.doi` | string | no | Length max 300. |
| `meta.citedBy` | integer | no | Value min 0. |

## Duplicates

### `duplicates_list`

**Duplicate groups** · Access: read

Possible duplicate groups (unresolved by default), most certain first, with their records. Each group has score (0-100 similarity of its weakest pair), signals (doi/pmid true|false|null, title 0-1, author, yearGap, journal) and aiSuggestion (pending verdict, if any).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `status` | `unresolved` \| `resolved` \| `not_duplicate` | no | Default `"unresolved"`. |

### `duplicates_suggest`

**Suggest a duplicate verdict** · Access: write, may replace

Write a verdict for one unresolved duplicate group - NOT a decision; the reviewer applies it in Collie › Duplicates. duplicate = every record is the same publication (keep_id = the most complete record); not_duplicate = at least one is a different publication (abstract vs full paper, interim vs final results, other registry entry); unsure = metadata cannot settle it. reason: 1-2 sentences citing the differing fields. Replaces an earlier suggestion on that group.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `group_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `verdict` | `duplicate` \| `not_duplicate` \| `unsure` | yes |  |
| `keep_id` | integer | no | Value above 0. |
| `reason` | string | yes | Length min 1, max 1000. |

### `ai_suggest`

**Suggest a screening decision (AI Reviewer)** · Access: write, may replace

Write an AI recommendation for one record - NOT a decision. Apply only the review's criteria (criteria_get); on title/abstract use 'maybe' when information is insufficient, never exclude on doubt. justification: 1-3 sentences; criteria: which inclusion/exclusion criteria are met, violated or unclear; reasons: closest exclusion reasons (exclusion_reasons). The reviewer accepts or dismisses it in Collie.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `record_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `phase` | `title_abstract` \| `full_text` | no | Default `"title_abstract"`. |
| `value` | `include` \| `maybe` \| `exclude` | yes |  |
| `confidence` | number | yes | Value min 0, max 1. |
| `justification` | string | yes | Length min 1, max 2000. |
| `criteria` | object | no | Default `{}`. |
| `criteria.met` | array of string | no |  |
| `criteria.violated` | array of string | no |  |
| `criteria.unclear` | array of string | no |  |
| `reasons` | array of string | no | Items max 10. Default `[]`. |

### `ai_screen_run`

**Run the built-in AI Reviewer** · Access: write, may replace, external

Only when ai_status says configured: Collie screens up to `limit` of YOUR undecided records with Claude and stores suggestions (never decisions). Returns {processed, skipped, failed, remaining} - call again while remaining > 0. Without API access, write suggestions yourself with ai_suggest.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `phase` | `title_abstract` \| `full_text` | no | Default `"title_abstract"`. |
| `limit` | integer | no | Value min 1, max 200. Default `50`. |
| `overwrite` | boolean | no | Default `false`. |

### `relevance_compute`

**Compute relevance scores** · Access: write

Score every record 0-1 against the review question (offline BM25; default query = title, description, inclusion criteria, search terms).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `query` | string | no | Length max 2000. |

### `ask_data`

**Ask your data** · Access: read

Question over the review's loaded articles: returns the most relevant references (0-1 relevance) and, when Collie has Claude access, a cited answer. Without it (mode 'retrieval-only'), answer yourself strictly from the returned references and cite them.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `question` | string | yes | Length min 1, max 2000. |
| `scope` | `all` \| `include` \| `maybe` \| `exclude` \| `undecided` \| `full_text` | no | Default `"all"`. |
| `min_relevance` | number | no | Value min 0, max 1. Default `0.15`. |
| `k` | integer | no | Value min 3, max 40. Default `12`. |
| `qa_mode` | `strict` \| `synthesis` \| `find` | no | Default `"strict"`. |
| `include_full_text` | boolean | no | Default `false`. |

### `screening_decide`

**Record a screening decision** · Access: write, may replace

RECORD A FINAL DECISION as the token's account (counts as a reviewer vote). Prefer ai_suggest - the human then accepts or dismisses it. Only use this when the user explicitly set the agent up as a second reviewer with its own account. Use 'maybe' when uncertain.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `record_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `phase` | `title_abstract` \| `full_text` \| `extraction` \| `rob` | no | Default `"title_abstract"`. |
| `value` | `include` \| `maybe` \| `exclude` | yes |  |
| `reasons` | array of string | no | Items max 10. Default `[]`. |
| `justification` | string | no | Length max 2000. |

### `extraction_questions_get`

### `ai_extraction_put`

**Propose extracted answers** · Access: write, may replace

Write answers to one extraction question for one record, each with a VERBATIM quote copied from the article (pdf_text or abstract). Collie locates every quote and flags unverifiable ones; a human approves. not_found=true when the article doesn't report it. Never infer numbers.

### `outcome_data_put`

Only values reported in the article; a converted value (SD from CI/SE, median/IQR) only when the protocol or user approves, with estimated:true and conversionLog [{field, method}]. Returns {saved, errors[{index, issues}]}.

## Risk of bias

### `rob_tools`

**Risk-of-bias tools** · Access: read

RoB 2, ROBINS-I, NOS, QUADAS-2, QUIPS, JBI: domain/section labels, allowed levels per domain (NOS: star counts), overall levels, citation and official link. Collie carries no item or question text: reviewers use the official forms.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |

### `rob_assess`

**Propose risk-of-bias assessment** · Access: write, may replace

Save a DRAFT RoB assessment for a study (optionally per outcome) under the token's account: suggest domainJudgement {domainId: level} using the levels rob_tools lists (NOS: stars per section; JBI: overallJudgement Include|Exclude|Seek further info and support.checklist notes) with support {domainId: a VERBATIM quote from the study plus a one-line rationale}. Never send question-by-question answers. Partial drafts merge with the stored one; a human finalises and sets consensus.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `studyId` | integer | yes |  |
| `outcomeId` | integer or null | no | Default `null`. |
| `tool` | `rob2` \| `robins_i` \| `nos` \| `quadas2` \| `quips` \| `jbi_case_series` \| `jbi_case_report` \| `jbi_prevalence` | yes |  |
| `variant` | string or null | no |  |
| `domainJudgement` | object of string or null | no |  |
| `overallJudgement` | string or null | no |  |
| `support` | object of string | no |  |

| `outcomeId` | integer | no |  |

**Risk-of-bias publication figures (robvis)** · Access: write

Generates robvis traffic-light and weighted summary plots from the review's completed RoB assessments (rob2, robins_i, quadas2, quips; not NOS/JBI). Studies with an unjudged domain are skipped and listed. Returns file URLs (svg/png/pdf).

## Analysis

### `outcome_analyze`

**Meta-analyse an extracted outcome** · Access: write

Run R {meta} on an outcome's extracted data (first intervention vs first control arm). Options: measure (RR/OR/RD/HR/MD/SMD…), model random|common, method_tau (REML default), hakn (default true), method (Inverse|MH|Peto|GLMM), leave_one_out, trimfill, subgroupKey (covariate name), labels {e,c,left,right,outcome}, formats [svg,png,pdf,tiff], dpi, bayes {enabled, mu_sd, tau_scale}. Returns estimates, skipped studies and file URLs.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `outcome_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `options` | object of any | no | Default `{}`. |

### `analysis_run`

**Run meta-analysis in R** · Access: write

Run a pairwise meta-analysis with R {meta} (RevMan 5 forest plot, heterogeneity, prediction interval, leave-one-out, Egger when k>=10, optional Bayesian bayesmeta). studies rows by type — binary: study,event.e,n.e,event.c,n.c; continuous: study,mean.e,sd.e,n.e,mean.c,sd.c,n.c; generic: study,TE,seTE (log scale for ratios); proportion: study,events,n (PLOGIT pools by GLMM); correlation: study,cor,n (ZCOR). Small-study test (Harbord for OR, else Egger; none for SMD/proportions) and trim-and-fill (sensitivity) only when k>=10. formats adds pdf/tiff at dpi (default 600). Defaults: random effects, REML, Hartung-Knapp (hakn true). Returns estimates and URLs of forest/loo/funnel figures and a reproducible analysis.R. Prefer outcome_analyze when the data are extracted in Collie.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `spec` | object | yes |  |
| `spec.type` | `binary` \| `continuous` \| `generic` \| `proportion` \| `correlation` | yes |  |
| `spec.measure` | `RR` \| `OR` \| `RD` \| `HR` \| `IRR` \| `MD` \| `SMD` \| `ROM` \| `PLOGIT` \| `PRAW` \| `PFT` \| `ZCOR` | yes |  |
| `spec.model` | `random` \| `common` | no | Default `"random"`. |
| `spec.method_tau` | `REML` \| `DL` \| `PM` \| `ML` \| `HS` \| `SJ` \| `HE` \| `EB` | no | Default `"REML"`. |
| `spec.hakn` | boolean | no | Default `true`. |
| `spec.subgroup` | boolean | no | Default `false`. |
| `spec.method` | `Inverse` \| `MH` \| `Peto` \| `GLMM` | no |  |
| `spec.trimfill` | boolean | no |  |
| `spec.formats` | array of `svg` \| `png` \| `pdf` \| `tiff` | no |  |
| `spec.dpi` | integer | no | Value min 72, max 1200. |
| `spec.leave_one_out` | boolean | no |  |
| `spec.labels` | object of string | no |  |
| `spec.bayes` | object | no |  |
| `spec.bayes.enabled` | boolean | yes |  |
| `spec.bayes.mu_sd` | number | no |  |
| `spec.bayes.tau_scale` | number | no |  |
| `spec.studies` | array of object of string or number | yes | Items min 2. |

## GRADE

### `grade_get`

**GRADE certainty per outcome** · Access: read

Every outcome with its GRADE assessment (design, ratings, reasons, certainty 1-4 / level), Collie's suggested ratings with reasons (from RoB, I2/prediction interval, CI vs null, small-study test), the latest pooled result and Summary-of-Findings evidence.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |

### `grade_set`

**Save a GRADE assessment** · Access: write, may replace

Saves one outcome's GRADE judgement; certainty is recomputed by Collie. Downgrades 0|-1|-2 (risk_of_bias, inconsistency, indirectness, imprecision, publication_bias); upgrades only for observational evidence (large_effect 0-2, dose_response 0-1, confounding 0-1). Every non-zero rating needs a reason. Only for an outcome with no GRADE yet (else 409 grade_exists: a person changes saved judgements). Agents propose; save only what the reviewer approved.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `review_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `outcome_id` | integer | yes | Value above 0. |
| `design` | `rct` \| `observational` | yes |  |
| `ratings` | object of integer | no |  |
| `reasons` | object of string | no |  |
| `sof` | object | no |  |
| `sof.participants` | string | no |  |
| `sof.studies` | string | no |  |
| `sof.relative` | string | no |  |
| `sof.absolute` | string | no |  |
| `sof.comments` | string | no |  |
